context: Japanese YouTube paranormal investigation videos (心霊検証動画 / 事故物件検証) feature top creators like Hajime Syacho (はじめしゃちょー) and Fischer's (フィッシャーズ / シルクロード) conducting solo or small-group overnight stay verifications (宿泊検証 / 1人検証) at notorious haunted houses, stigmatized properties (事故物件 - jikobukken), and rooms housing dangerous cursed objects (呪物 - jubutsu), such as the infamous Blue House (青い家) or setups connected to cursed item collector Tanaka Toshiyuki (田中俊行). Creators utilize detection gear including ghost detectors (ばけたん / Baketan), Spirit Boxes (スピリットボックス), and EMF meters (EMF探知機) to capture strange phenomena (怪奇現象 / 霊障), poltergeists (ポルターガイスト), or audio-visual anomalies, often leading to panic, sleep paralysis (金縛り), or emergency shooting halts (撮影中断). The speech register ranges from energetic intro banter and nervous chatter to panicked shrieks, hushed midnight whispers, and urgent real-time reactions. Produce natural Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) subtitles that accurately mirror this mix of humor and horror while strictly employing the exact Taiwan Traditional Chinese glossary terms.
